description: Get individual unit-level forecasts by assessor account number. This is the finest resolution available; covers individual condo units, SFRs, and townhouses. Use include_siblings=true to get all units in the same condo building. Coverage: Florida statewide + Houston metro.

acct.description: Assessor account number. FL DOR: '00404328020003500'. Houston HCAD: 10-13 digit account.

include_siblings.description: If true and unit is a condo, also return all sibling units in the same building (condo_group). Default: false.

name: forecast_by_unit

result.description: Raw JSON response body returned by the Homecastr API.
